**画出来要什么**
页面含一幅四系列横向百分比堆叠条形图，以及两幅并排的单系列横条图。所有数值置于条内；数值轴及刻度隐藏。首图图例在下方，三图均有分类轴和注释行。

**定位一个值难在哪**
首图的39%出现两次：China和Rep. of Korea均对应“Important”。唯一定位必须同时保留国家轴标签与图例系列名。

**不确定的**
下方两图共享说明文字且并排布局，也可能被设计者视为一个双面板图；这里按各自独立标题判作两幅图。

All eight stacks have equal full width and their segment labels are percentages.
Country categories run vertically while all stacked bars extend rightward.
No numeric value ticks are drawn; percentages are printed inside segments.
The four-item legend sits in one row beneath the stacked bars.
Every percentage, including “8%” and “49%”, is printed inside its segment.
“US” and “UK” are category-axis abbreviations.
“Note: Percentages may not add up to 100 due to rounding.” appears below.
Eight teal bars extend rightward from the country labels.
No numeric value ticks appear; each teal bar carries its percentage.
Labels from “76%” through “34%” sit inside the teal bars.
“US” and “UK” are category-axis abbreviations.
The heading begins “Percentage of surveyed consumers”.
“Q61.” and the shared “Sample size” line appear beneath the lower charts.
Eight green bars extend rightward from the country labels.
No numeric value ticks appear; each green bar carries its percentage.
Labels from “82%” through “32%” sit inside the green bars.
“UK” and “US” are category-axis abbreviations.
The heading begins “Percentage of surveyed consumers”.
“Q60.” and the shared “Sample size” line appear beneath the lower charts.
One stacked chart and two separately headed bar charts appear on the page.
